soul_corrections.correction: List the full BBG kit. Primaries: Boomstick, Doomstick, Balance Beam, Señor Potato, Pie Bomb, Chainsaw Shotgun, Bubble Gun, Buster Cannon, Snowtato Launcher. Secondaries: Batterito, Killdoba, EZ Chee-Z, Whipped Pain, Sole's Bane, Pop Tart Shuriken. Melees: Bow, Arrow, Bow and Arrow, Traffic Light, Selfie Stick. Default loadout: Boomstick, Batterito, Bow. BBG's Boomstick is a hitscan pump shotgun with no splash [Fan-wiki]; the 'explosive pellets' Boomstick is the BBH version [Canon text; BBH by Inference].
